governing_scope_interpretation.defect_closure_requirement_exact: Add regression coverage for an initial request racing tap installation and a delayed old-document response arriving after navigation loading; prove current-document attribution and honest retrigger guidance. Then verify saved request replay on a real public website using an installed build.
governing_scope_interpretation.showcase_plan_closure_exact: A defect closes only after original reproduction and surrounding cases pass with a fresh independent verifier. Unit tests are diagnosis/regression evidence, not UI proof. No whole-feature health claim until each applicable inventory cell resolves.
governing_scope_interpretation.t57_public_precondition_exact: Fresh development build; verify receipt and reload the extension and page in Chrome. Use a real public website with a reproducible request during initial document load and an owned recipe. No localhost/test server. Guest/member denial uses EXT-F-1012-T38.
governing_scope_interpretation.t57_ordered_step_exact: Start a replay with an old document response pending; after navigation begins and the new document starts, release the old response and then the current document response.
governing_scope_interpretation.interpretation: The defect-specific closure_requirement deliberately asks for regression coverage of the racing/delayed-response scenarios and then an installed public-site saved replay; it does not say the adversarial race must be staged on the public site or that both must use one artifact. The broader Showcase plan requires fresh independent UI review of original and surrounding behavior; the accepted controlled native sidepanel runs supply bounded UI behavior with positive Chrome controls and peers, while retained causal mutants supply the regression. The public HN run separately supplies real-site installed replay. The 2026-10-06 acceptance ruling said no closure at that checkpoint, before the later positive native and peer receipts; it listed proof conditions, not an immutable hold. T57 is stricter: its public-site precondition applies to its ordered old-then-current steps, so the integrated public-site scenario remains missing for the inventory cell. No requirement is waived or rewritten.
